name: AI Fitness Plan Generator
description: n8n automation workflow for user registration, login, fitness data processing, AI fitness plan generation, Google Sheets storage, and response delivery.

flow: Receive name, email, password and timestamp
Check Google Sheets for existing email
Save user information to Google Sheets
Return login success or invalid credentials
Extract user ID and fitness details
Store fitness information in Google Sheets
Extract structured workout and meal information
Save generated plan to Google Sheets

pdf_generation.description: The generated plan is returned to the website, where the website handles PDF generation and download.
